# Helper Functions and Constants

```{r helper-functions}
# "not in" operator
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# Indicators excluded from main Tables 1–2 and Figures 1–3 only
exclude_indicators_main <- c("Protective food consumption", "Unhealthy food consumption")

# Column / row ordering vectors
col_order <- c("country", "M49_code", "ISO3", "indicator", "year", "value", "unit")
row_order <- c("country", "year", "variable_order")

# CAGR -----------------------------------------------------------------------
calculate_cagr <- function(start_value, start_year, end_value, end_year) {
  if (start_year == end_year || is.na(start_value) || is.na(end_value)) return(NA_real_)
  if (start_value <= 0 || end_value <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  ((end_value / start_value)^(1 / (end_year - start_year)) - 1) * 100
}

# Accelerated CAGR to reach a target ----------------------------------------
calculate_accelerated_cagr <- function(start_value, start_year, target_value, target_year) {
  if (start_year == target_year || is.na(start_value) || is.na(target_value)) return(NA_real_)
  if (start_value <= 0 || target_value <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  ((target_value / start_value)^(1 / (target_year - start_year)) - 1) * 100
}

# Exponential moving average -------------------------------------------------
calculate_ema <- function(data, alpha = 0.5) {
  data %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    mutate(
      ema_value = value[1],
      ema_value = accumulate(value[-1],
                             ~ alpha * .y + (1 - alpha) * .x,
                             .init = value[1])
    ) %>%
    pull(ema_value) %>%
    last()
}

# Save GT tables as HTML + PNG + PDF + DOCX ----------------------------------
save_table_as_html_png_pdf <- function(gt_table, filename_base,
                                       vwidth = 2400, vheight = 1600, zoom = 3) {
  gtsave(gt_table, file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".html")))
  gtsave(gt_table, file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".png")),
         vwidth = vwidth, vheight = vheight, zoom = zoom)
  gtsave(gt_table, file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".docx")))
  Sys.sleep(2)
  img <- image_read(file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".png")))
  image_write(img,
              path    = file.path(figtab_out, paste0(filename_base, ".pdf")),
              format  = "pdf",
              density = "300x300")
  cat(paste0("✓ ", filename_base, " saved in HTML, PNG, PDF, and DOCX formats\n"))
}
```

# Part 1 – Load and Clean Data

```{r load-data}
analysis_data  <- readRDS(file.path(data_out, "FSCI_2025.rds"))
global_targets <- read_csv(file.path(data_out, "global_targets.csv"))

cat("Loaded", nrow(analysis_data),  "rows of analysis data\n")
cat("Loaded", nrow(global_targets), "global targets\n")
```

```{r clean-data}
# Harmonise short_label names in global_targets
global_targets <- global_targets %>%
  mutate(short_label = case_when(
    short_label == "Unhealthy foods"   ~ "Unhealthy food consumption",
    short_label == "Protective foods"  ~ "Protective food consumption",
    TRUE ~ short_label
  ))

# Clean analysis data
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(!(tolower(unit) %in% c("binary", "categorical"))) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value)) %>%
  filter(!short_label %in% c(
    "Conservation of genetic resources, animals",
    "Conservation of genetic resources, plants",
    "Disaster damages share of GDP",
    "Emissions intensity, cereals (excl. rice)",
    "Yield, fruit", "Yield, cereals", "Yield, vegetables",
    "Milan urban food policy pact", "Cost of healthy diet",
    "Yield, milk", "Yield, beef", "Food system emissions"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    short_label = case_when(
      short_label == "Unhealthy foods"  ~ "Unhealthy food consumption",
      short_label == "Protective foods" ~ "Protective food consumption",
      TRUE ~ short_label
    ),
    desirable_direction = as.numeric(desirable_direction),
    desirable_direction = case_when(
      short_label == "Unhealthy food consumption"  ~ -1,
      short_label == "Protective food consumption" ~  1,
      TRUE ~ desirable_direction
    ),
    theme = case_when(
      short_label == "Unhealthy food consumption"                        ~ "Diets, Nutrition, and Health",
      short_label == "Protective food consumption"                       ~ "Diets, Nutrition, and Health",
      theme == "Environment, Natural Resources and Production"           ~ "Environment, Natural Resources, and Production",
      TRUE ~ theme
    )
  )

cat("Data cleaning complete!\n")
```

# Part 2 – Calculate Benchmarks

```{r benchmarks}
# Most recent non-NA value per country/indicator (2015–2024)
latest_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year >= 2015 & year <= 2024) %>%
  group_by(country, short_label) %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Function: calculate benchmarks at a given grouping level
calculate_milestones <- function(data, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_vars, "short_label")))) %>%
    summarise(
      milestone = case_when(
        first(desirable_direction) ==  1 ~ mean(value[value >= quantile(value, 0.8, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
        first(desirable_direction) == -1 ~ mean(value[value <= quantile(value, 0.2, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      theme                = first(theme),
      desirable_direction  = first(desirable_direction),
      group_value = if ("UN Continental Region" %in% group_vars) first(`UN Continental Region`)
                   else if ("income_group" %in% group_vars) first(income_group)
                   else "Global",
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

milestones_global <- calculate_milestones(latest_data, group_vars = c()) %>%
  filter(short_label != "aginGDP")
milestones_region <- calculate_milestones(latest_data, group_vars = "UN Continental Region")
milestones_income <- calculate_milestones(latest_data, group_vars = "income_group")

# Combine and pivot wide
milestones_wide <- bind_rows(milestones_global, milestones_region, milestones_income) %>%
  select(short_label, theme, desirable_direction, group_value, milestone) %>%
  mutate(group_value = gsub(" ", "_", group_value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group_value, values_from = milestone, names_prefix = "benchmark_")

# Merge global targets
final_table <- milestones_wide %>%
  left_join(global_targets, by = "short_label") %>%
  relocate(target, .after = short_label) %>%
  select(-desirable_direction, -variable, -starts_with("benchmark_NA"))

# Ensure all expected benchmark columns exist
expected_cols <- c(
  "benchmark_Global",
  "benchmark_Africa", "benchmark_Americas", "benchmark_Asia",
  "benchmark_Europe", "benchmark_Oceania",
  "benchmark_Low_income", "benchmark_Lower_middle_income",
  "benchmark_Upper_middle_income", "benchmark_High_income"
)
for (col in expected_cols) {
  if (!col %in% names(final_table)) final_table[[col]] <- NA_real_
}

# Add unit information
unit_info <- analysis_data %>%
  select(short_label, unit) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(short_label) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

final_table <- final_table %>%
  left_join(unit_info, by = "short_label") %>%
  relocate(unit, .after = short_label) %>%
  arrange(theme, short_label) %>%
  relocate(theme, .before = short_label)

cat("Calculated benchmarks for", nrow(final_table), "indicators\n")
```

# Part 3 – Historical Progress (BAU Projections)

```{r bau-projections}
calculate_bau_projection <- function(data, start_year = 2015, min_points = 2) {
  data %>%
    mutate(value = as.numeric(value)) %>%
    filter(year >= start_year, !is.na(value)) %>%
    group_by(country, short_label) %>%
    filter(n() >= min_points) %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    summarise(
      baseline_year  = first(year),
      latest_year    = last(year),
      baseline_value = first(value),
      latest_value   = last(value),
      year_span      = latest_year - baseline_year,
      bau_cagr       = calculate_cagr(first(value), first(year), last(value), last(year)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      distinct(select(data, country, short_label, theme, unit,
                      `UN Continental Region`, income_group, desirable_direction)),
      by = c("country", "short_label")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      v2030e = if_else(!is.na(bau_cagr),
                       latest_value * (1 + bau_cagr / 100)^(2030 - latest_year), NA_real_),
      v2050e = if_else(!is.na(bau_cagr),
                       latest_value * (1 + bau_cagr / 100)^(2050 - latest_year), NA_real_)
    )
}

bau_standard <- calculate_bau_projection(analysis_data, start_year = 2015, min_points = 2)
```

```{r single-point-countries}
add_single_point_meeting_targets <- function(original_data, bau_df, targets_df) {
  single_point_countries <- original_data %>%
    filter(year >= 2015, year <= 2025, !is.na(value)) %>%
    group_by(country, short_label) %>%
    filter(n() == 1) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(single_point_countries) == 0) return(bau_df)

  single_point_meeting <- single_point_countries %>%
    group_by(country, short_label) %>%
    summarise(
      baseline_year       = first(year),
      latest_year         = first(year),
      baseline_value      = first(value),
      latest_value        = first(value),
      year_span           = 0,
      bau_cagr            = 0,
      theme               = first(theme),
      `UN Continental Region` = first(`UN Continental Region`),
      income_group        = first(income_group),
      desirable_direction = first(desirable_direction),
      unit                = first(unit),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(v2030e = latest_value, v2050e = latest_value) %>%
    left_join(targets_df, by = "short_label", suffix = c("", ".target")) %>%
    mutate(
      target_value = coalesce(target, benchmark_Global),
      meets_target = case_when(
        is.na(target_value) | is.na(latest_value)             ~ FALSE,
        desirable_direction ==  1 & latest_value >= target_value ~ TRUE,
        desirable_direction == -1 & latest_value <= target_value ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(meets_target) %>%
    select(country, short_label, baseline_year, latest_year, baseline_value, latest_value,
           year_span, bau_cagr, theme, `UN Continental Region`, income_group,
           desirable_direction, unit, v2030e, v2050e)

  bind_rows(bau_df, single_point_meeting)
}

bau_expanded <- add_single_point_meeting_targets(analysis_data, bau_standard, final_table)
cat("BAU projections calculated for", nrow(bau_expanded), "country-indicator combinations\n")
```

# Part 4 – Challenge Classification

```{r classify-challenges}
classify_bau_progress <- function(bau_df, targets_df, milestone_year = 2030) {
  end_col <- ifelse(milestone_year == 2030, "v2030e", "v2050e")

  if (!"desirable_direction" %in% names(targets_df)) {
    targets_df <- targets_df %>%
      left_join(distinct(select(bau_df, short_label, desirable_direction)), by = "short_label")
  }

  benchmark_cols <- c("target", "benchmark_Global",
                      "benchmark_Africa", "benchmark_Americas", "benchmark_Asia",
                      "benchmark_Europe", "benchmark_Oceania",
                      "benchmark_Low_income", "benchmark_Lower_middle_income",
                      "benchmark_Upper_middle_income", "benchmark_High_income")
  for (col in benchmark_cols[!benchmark_cols %in% names(targets_df)]) {
    targets_df[[col]] <- NA_real_
  }

  bau_df %>%
    filter(year_span > 0) %>%
    left_join(targets_df, by = "short_label", suffix = c(".bau", ".target")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      region_col_name  = paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", `UN Continental Region`)),
      income_col_name  = paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", income_group)),
      region_benchmark = ifelse(region_col_name %in% names(targets_df),
                                targets_df[[region_col_name]][targets_df$short_label == short_label][1], NA_real_),
      income_benchmark = ifelse(income_col_name %in% names(targets_df),
                                targets_df[[income_col_name]][targets_df$short_label == short_label][1], NA_real_),
      target_value     = coalesce(target, benchmark_Global)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      progress_ratio = case_when(
        is.na(!!sym(end_col)) | is.na(baseline_value) | is.na(target_value) ~ NA_real_,
        (desirable_direction.bau ==  1 & baseline_value >= target_value) |
          (desirable_direction.bau == -1 & baseline_value <= target_value) ~ 1,
        desirable_direction.bau ==  1 & target_value > baseline_value ~
          (!!sym(end_col) - baseline_value) / (target_value - baseline_value),
        desirable_direction.bau == -1 & target_value < baseline_value ~
          (baseline_value - !!sym(end_col)) / (baseline_value - target_value),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      current_distance_pct = case_when(
        is.na(latest_value) | is.na(target_value) ~ NA_real_,
        (desirable_direction.bau ==  1 & latest_value >= target_value) |
          (desirable_direction.bau == -1 & latest_value <= target_value) ~ 0,
        desirable_direction.bau ==  1 & target_value > latest_value ~
          abs((target_value - latest_value) / target_value) * 100,
        desirable_direction.bau == -1 & target_value < latest_value ~
          abs((latest_value - target_value) / target_value) * 100,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      distance_category = case_when(
        is.na(current_distance_pct)  ~ "Insufficient data",
        current_distance_pct < 10   ~ "At target (0-10%)",
        current_distance_pct < 33   ~ "Close (10-33%)",
        current_distance_pct < 67   ~ "Moderate (33-67%)",
        TRUE                         ~ "Far (67%+)"
      ),
      projected_value   = !!sym(end_col),
      challenge_category = case_when(
        is.na(progress_ratio)    ~ "Insufficient data",
        progress_ratio >= 0.95   ~ "On target or target met",
        progress_ratio >= 0.50   ~ "Moderate progress",
        progress_ratio >= 0.10   ~ "Marginal progress",
        progress_ratio >= 0      ~ "Stagnation",
        progress_ratio <  0      ~ "Regression",
        TRUE                     ~ "Insufficient data"
      ),
      target_source = case_when(
        !is.na(target)           ~ "Global target",
        !is.na(benchmark_Global) ~ "Global benchmark",
        !is.na(region_benchmark) ~ "Regional benchmark",
        !is.na(income_benchmark) ~ "Income group benchmark",
        TRUE                     ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-region_col_name, -income_col_name, -region_benchmark, -income_benchmark) %>%
    rename(desirable_direction = desirable_direction.bau,
           theme = theme.bau,
           unit  = unit.bau) %>%
    select(-matches("\\.target$"))
}

classified_2030 <- classify_bau_progress(bau_standard, final_table, milestone_year = 2030)
classified_2050 <- classify_bau_progress(bau_standard, final_table, milestone_year = 2050)

cat("Classified", nrow(classified_2030), "entries for 2030 targets\n")
cat("Classified", nrow(classified_2050), "entries for 2050 targets\n")
```

# Part 5 – Distance Calculations

```{r distances}
calculate_country_distances <- function(data, benchmarks) {
  latest_country_data <- data %>%
    group_by(country, short_label) %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup()

  latest_country_data %>%
    left_join(select(benchmarks, short_label, target, starts_with("benchmark_")),
              by = "short_label") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      region_col_name    = paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", `UN Continental Region`)),
      income_col_name    = paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", income_group)),
      regional_benchmark = if (region_col_name %in% names(benchmarks))
        benchmarks[[region_col_name]][benchmarks$short_label == short_label][1] else NA_real_,
      income_benchmark   = if (income_col_name %in% names(benchmarks))
        benchmarks[[income_col_name]][benchmarks$short_label == short_label][1] else NA_real_,

      # Directional absolute distances
      dir_abs_distance_to_target   = case_when(
        is.na(target)            | is.na(value) ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ value - target,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ target - value, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
      dir_abs_distance_to_global   = case_when(
        is.na(benchmark_Global)  | is.na(value) ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ value - benchmark_Global,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ benchmark_Global - value, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
      dir_abs_distance_to_regional = case_when(
        is.na(regional_benchmark)| is.na(value) ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ value - regional_benchmark,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ regional_benchmark - value, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
      dir_abs_distance_to_income   = case_when(
        is.na(income_benchmark)  | is.na(value) ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ value - income_benchmark,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ income_benchmark - value, TRUE ~ NA_real_),

      # Directional percentage distances
      dir_pct_distance_to_target   = case_when(
        is.na(target)            | is.na(value) | value == 0 ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ (value - target)            / abs(value) * 100,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ (target - value)            / abs(value) * 100, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
      dir_pct_distance_to_global   = case_when(
        is.na(benchmark_Global)  | is.na(value) | value == 0 ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ (value - benchmark_Global)  / abs(value) * 100,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ (benchmark_Global - value)  / abs(value) * 100, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
      dir_pct_distance_to_regional = case_when(
        is.na(regional_benchmark)| is.na(value) | value == 0 ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ (value - regional_benchmark)/ abs(value) * 100,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ (regional_benchmark - value)/ abs(value) * 100, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
      dir_pct_distance_to_income   = case_when(
        is.na(income_benchmark)  | is.na(value) | value == 0 ~ NA_real_,
        desirable_direction ==  1 ~ (value - income_benchmark)  / abs(value) * 100,
        desirable_direction == -1 ~ (income_benchmark - value)  / abs(value) * 100, TRUE ~ NA_real_),

      # Status flags
      meets_target   = if_else((desirable_direction ==  1 & value >= target)   |
                                (desirable_direction == -1 & value <= target),   1L, 0L),
      meets_global   = if_else((desirable_direction ==  1 & value >= benchmark_Global) |
                                (desirable_direction == -1 & value <= benchmark_Global), 1L, 0L),
      meets_regional = if_else((desirable_direction ==  1 & value >= regional_benchmark) |
                                (desirable_direction == -1 & value <= regional_benchmark), 1L, 0L),
      meets_income   = if_else((desirable_direction ==  1 & value >= income_benchmark) |
                                (desirable_direction == -1 & value <= income_benchmark), 1L, 0L)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-region_col_name, -income_col_name)
}

country_distance_data <- calculate_country_distances(analysis_data, final_table)
country_distances_df  <- country_distance_data

cat("Distances calculated for", nrow(country_distance_data), "country-indicator combinations\n")
```

```{r mean-distances}
calculate_mean_distances <- function(distance_data) {
  global_means <- distance_data %>%
    group_by(short_label) %>%
    summarise(group_type = "Global", group_name = "Global",
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_target   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_target,   na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_global   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_global,   na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_regional = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_regional, na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_income   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_income,   na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")

  regional_means <- distance_data %>%
    group_by(short_label, `UN Continental Region`) %>%
    summarise(group_type = "Regional", group_name = first(`UN Continental Region`),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_target   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_target,   na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_global   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_global,   na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_regional = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_regional, na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_income   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_income,   na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    select(-`UN Continental Region`)

  income_means <- distance_data %>%
    group_by(short_label, income_group) %>%
    summarise(group_type = "Income", group_name = first(income_group),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_target   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_target,   na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_global   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_global,   na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_regional = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_regional, na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_dir_abs_distance_to_income   = mean(dir_abs_distance_to_income,   na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    select(-income_group)

  bind_rows(global_means, regional_means, income_means)
}

mean_benchmark_distances <- calculate_mean_distances(country_distance_data)
```

# Part 6 – Required Progress (EMA Trajectories)

```{r ema-trajectories}
calculate_ema_trajectories <- function(data, benchmarks, alpha = 0.5) {
  country_indicator_data <- data %>%
    group_by(country, short_label) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
    arrange(year)

  ema_data <- country_indicator_data %>%
    mutate(ema_value = purrr::accumulate(
      value,
      ~ if (is.na(.x)) .y else alpha * .y + (1 - alpha) * .x,
      .init = value[1]
    )[-1]) %>%
    ungroup()

  latest_country_ema <- ema_data %>%
    group_by(country, short_label) %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    mutate(baseline_value = ema_value, baseline_year = year) %>%
    ungroup()

  latest_country_ema %>%
    left_join(select(benchmarks, short_label, target, starts_with("benchmark_")),
              by = "short_label") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      region_col_name    = paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", `UN Continental Region`)),
      income_col_name    = paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", income_group)),
      regional_benchmark = if (region_col_name %in% names(benchmarks))
        benchmarks[[region_col_name]][benchmarks$short_label == short_label][1] else NA_real_,
      income_benchmark   = if (income_col_name %in% names(benchmarks))
        benchmarks[[income_col_name]][benchmarks$short_label == short_label][1] else NA_real_,

      ema_cagr_to_target_2030 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= target ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= target ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, target, 2030)),
      ema_cagr_to_target_2050 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= target ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= target ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, target, 2050)),
      ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= benchmark_Global ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= benchmark_Global ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, benchmark_Global, 2030)),
      ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= benchmark_Global ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= benchmark_Global ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, benchmark_Global, 2050)),
      ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2030 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= regional_benchmark ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= regional_benchmark ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, regional_benchmark, 2030)),
      ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2050 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= regional_benchmark ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= regional_benchmark ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, regional_benchmark, 2050)),
      ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2030 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= income_benchmark ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= income_benchmark ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, income_benchmark, 2030)),
      ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2050 = case_when(
        desirable_direction ==  1 & baseline_value >= income_benchmark ~ 0,
        desirable_direction == -1 & baseline_value <= income_benchmark ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ calculate_accelerated_cagr(baseline_value, baseline_year, income_benchmark, 2050))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-region_col_name, -income_col_name, -regional_benchmark, -income_benchmark)
}

ema_accelerated_trajectories <- calculate_ema_trajectories(analysis_data, final_table, alpha = 0.5)
cat("EMA-based trajectories calculated for", nrow(ema_accelerated_trajectories), "entries\n")
```

```{r ema-cagr-summaries}
ema_cagr_summaries <- bind_rows(
  # Regional
  ema_accelerated_trajectories %>%
    group_by(`UN Continental Region`, short_label, theme, unit, desirable_direction) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030              = mean(ema_cagr_to_target_2030,              na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050              = mean(ema_cagr_to_target_2050,              na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030    = mean(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030,    na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050    = mean(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050,    na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2030  = mean(ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2030,  na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2050  = mean(ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2050,  na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2030    = mean(ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2030,    na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2050    = mean(ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2050,    na.rm = TRUE),
      countries_with_ema_target_cagr            = sum(!is.na(ema_cagr_to_target_2030)),
      countries_with_ema_global_cagr            = sum(!is.na(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(group_type = "Regional", group_name = `UN Continental Region`) %>%
    select(-`UN Continental Region`),
  # Income
  ema_accelerated_trajectories %>%
    group_by(income_group, short_label, theme, unit, desirable_direction) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2030              = mean(ema_cagr_to_target_2030,              na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_target_2050              = mean(ema_cagr_to_target_2050,              na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030    = mean(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030,    na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050    = mean(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050,    na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2030  = mean(ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2030,  na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2050  = mean(ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2050,  na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2030    = mean(ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2030,    na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2050    = mean(ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2050,    na.rm = TRUE),
      countries_with_ema_target_cagr            = sum(!is.na(ema_cagr_to_target_2030)),
      countries_with_ema_global_cagr            = sum(!is.na(ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(group_type = "Income", group_name = income_group) %>%
    select(-income_group)
)
```

# Part 7 – Comprehensive Country-Level Spreadsheet

```{r country-spreadsheet}
# Data coverage
data_coverage <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(country, short_label) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  summarise(
    total_data_points = n(),
    year_range = paste0(min(year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(year, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

comprehensive_country_data <- country_distance_data %>%
  left_join(data_coverage, by = c("country", "short_label")) %>%
  left_join(
    bau_expanded %>%
      select(country, short_label, baseline_year, baseline_value, latest_year,
             latest_value, bau_cagr, v2030e, v2050e),
    by = c("country", "short_label"), suffix = c("", "_bau")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    classified_2030 %>% select(country, short_label, progress_ratio, challenge_category),
    by = c("country", "short_label"), suffix = c("", "_class")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ema_accelerated_trajectories %>%
      select(country, short_label, starts_with("ema_cagr_")),
    by = c("country", "short_label")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    regional_benchmark_value = {
      col <- paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", `UN Continental Region`))
      if (col %in% names(final_table)) final_table[[col]][final_table$short_label == short_label][1]
      else NA_real_
    },
    income_benchmark_value = {
      col <- paste0("benchmark_", gsub(" ", "_", income_group))
      if (col %in% names(final_table)) final_table[[col]][final_table$short_label == short_label][1]
      else NA_real_
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    distance_to_target_abs_cond        = if_else(!is.na(target), dir_abs_distance_to_target, NA_real_),
    distance_to_target_pct_cond        = if_else(!is.na(target), dir_pct_distance_to_target, NA_real_),
    progress_ratio_target_cond         = if_else(!is.na(target), progress_ratio,             NA_real_),
    challenge_category_target_cond     = if_else(!is.na(target), challenge_category,         NA_character_),
    bau_cagr_cond                      = if_else(is.na(target),  bau_cagr,                   NA_real_),
    progress_ratio_global_cond         = if_else(is.na(target),  progress_ratio,             NA_real_),
    challenge_category_global_cond     = if_else(is.na(target),  challenge_category,         NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Country                = country,
    `UN Continental Region`,
    `World Bank Country Income Group`                         = income_group,
    Indicator                                                 = short_label,
    Unit                                                      = unit,
    `Total Data Points`                                       = total_data_points,
    `Year Range of Total Data Points`                         = year_range,
    `Latest Data Year`                                        = year,
    `Latest Value`                                            = value,
    `Target Value`                                            = target,
    `Distance to Target (absolute)`                           = distance_to_target_abs_cond,
    `Distance to Target (normalized percentage)`              = distance_to_target_pct_cond,
    `Progress Ratio to Target`                                = progress_ratio_target_cond,
    `Historical Progress Classification to Target`            = challenge_category_target_cond,
    `Required Progress to Target 2030 using EMA method`       = ema_cagr_to_target_2030,
    `Required Progress to Target 2050 using EMA method`       = ema_cagr_to_target_2050,
    `Global Benchmark Value`                                  = benchmark_Global,
    `Distance to Global Benchmark (absolute)`                 = dir_abs_distance_to_global,
    `Distance to Global Benchmark (normalized percentage)`    = dir_pct_distance_to_global,
    `Business as usual CAGR (only if there is no Global Target)` = bau_cagr_cond,
    `Progress Ratio (only if there is no Global Target)`      = progress_ratio_global_cond,
    `Historical Progress Classification (only if there is no Global Target)` = challenge_category_global_cond,
    `Required Progress to Global Benchmark 2030 using EMA method` = ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2030,
    `Required Progress to Global Benchmark 2050 using EMA method` = ema_cagr_to_global_benchmark_2050,
    `Regional Benchmark Value`                                = regional_benchmark_value,
    `Distance to Regional Benchmark (absolute)`               = dir_abs_distance_to_regional,
    `Distance to Regional Benchmark (normalized percentage)`  = dir_pct_distance_to_regional,
    `Required Progress to Regional Benchmark 2030 using EMA method` = ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2030,
    `Required Progress to Regional Benchmark 2050 using EMA method` = ema_cagr_to_regional_benchmark_2050,
    `Income Benchmark Value`                                  = income_benchmark_value,
    `Distance to Income Benchmark (absolute)`                 = dir_abs_distance_to_income,
    `Distance to Income Benchmark (normalized percentage)`    = dir_pct_distance_to_income,
    `Required Progress to Income Benchmark 2030 using EMA method` = ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2030,
    `Required Progress to Income Benchmark 2050 using EMA method` = ema_cagr_to_income_benchmark_2050
  ) %>%
  arrange(Country, Indicator)

output_file <- file.path(figtab_out, "Comprehensive_Country_Level_Data.csv")
write.csv(comprehensive_country_data, output_file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")

cat("Comprehensive spreadsheet saved:", output_file, "\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(comprehensive_country_data), "| Countries:",
    length(unique(comprehensive_country_data$Country)), "| Indicators:",
    length(unique(comprehensive_country_data$Indicator)), "\n")
```
